# Poe2NetworkAccessor

[API index](../index)

Script-facing network-message commands — `World.Network`.

## Send

```typescript
Send(channel: string, content: string): Promise<void>;
```

Requires feature: `PoE.Follow`.

Queue a message for `channel`. Bare channel names resolve to the signed-in user's PoEBane
namespace; a full `eye://`/`local://`/`broadcast://` route is used as supplied. At runtime
this returns a Promise that resolves when the channel service accepts the message.
